Bug_Details:
Avoid the use temporary objects when converting primitives to Strings. Use the static conversion methods
on the wrapper classes instead.
Examples:
public String convert(int x) {
    String foo = new Integer(x).toString(); // this wastes an object

    return Integer.toString(x);             // preferred approach
}
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by using a temporary Integer object to convert an int primitive to a String. This is inefficient as it creates an unnecessary object when the static method Integer.toString(x) could be used instead.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the'showBug' method which uses a temporary Integer object to convert an int to a String, triggering the UnnecessaryConversionTemporary bug.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results indicate that the test passed successfully without any errors or failures. This does not provide evidence that the unnecessary conversion bug was triggered, as the test only checks if the output is '42', which is correct regardless of how the conversion is performed.
